question: Should this draft introduce consent-gated Claws workspace/persona file writes with `--workspace` in core now, and should it stay behind the open Claws prerequisite stack?
rationale: The PR adds a new mutating CLI path, durable shared-state rows, and a workspace file-write boundary, so automation cannot decide product sequencing or the permanent security contract.

options.title: Hold For Stack And Boundary
options.body: Keep the draft open until maintainers accept the Claws RFC/prerequisite PRs and the workspace write boundary.

options.title: Narrow The Surface
options.body: Defer the mutating `--workspace` behavior and keep this slice to non-mutating or state-only Claws work.

options.title: Accept The Boundary
options.body: Proceed with this mutating core behavior once maintainers explicitly own the upgrade and security-boundary implications.

recommendation.title: Hold For Stack And Boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open until maintainers accept the Claws RFC/prerequisite PRs and the workspace write boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved decision is primarily about security/file-write boundary acceptance, and vincentkoc is the strongest listed security-adjacent owner among the relevant history signals.
